scenarios.prompt: Review a C diff that uses sprintf into a fixed buffer and malloc(sizeof(type *)) for a struct.

scenarios.prompt: A C init function acquires three resources and frees them ad-hoc in each error branch; one branch leaks.
expected: requires the centralized cleanup exit (goto cleanup) pattern with reverse-order release
treats leak on error path as critical, not style
